input.text: Resolve complaints within 30 business days of receipt, or tell the customer when to expect a resolution.

input.text: Keep your drawer locked whenever you step away from the teller line.
input.heading: Which cash transactions go to large-cash review?

input.text: Limit fee waivers to three per account in each calendar year.
input.heading: How many fee waivers can one account get in a year?

document.title: Fee Refund Questions
document.applies_to: All branches. Consumer and small business accounts.

input.text: Outgoing wires of $10,000 or more require a callback to the customer at a number already on file.
input.heading: Which outgoing wires need a callback?

input.text: An operations manager must give a second approval for any outgoing wire above $50,000.
input.heading: Which outgoing wires need a second approval?

input.text: Callbacks are completed by an operations employee, never by the employee who took the request.
input.heading: Who completes the callback for an outgoing wire?

input.text: Never accept wire instructions sent by email without verifying them by phone.
input.heading: What is the cutoff for outgoing consumer wires?

input.text: Call the customer back at a phone number already on file before releasing any outgoing wire of $10,000 or more.
input.heading: Which outgoing wires need a callback?

input.text: Only a teller may complete the callback for an outgoing wire.
